layers.perInvocationAuthorizationRecord: The closed schema at authorizationRecord. One record per attempted in-scope host act. Distinct from this design contract.
layers.productAdmission: A separate owner-recorded act naming the exact surface or subtype. This contract cannot admit a surface. Named at productAdmission.

governingDecisions.D-002: architecture-preview command set includes doctor (read-only/no-network default, consented probes). This artifact does not rewrite that set.

inScope: host process acting under the invoking user's direct instruction (CLI/CI)
outOfScope: component-originated egress (DR-105 / PT-NET-EGRESS referenced, not minted)

failClosed.rulePositive: An in-scope host act is exercisable only when every required condition below is true. Equivalently, absence of any required condition denies. Denial is not (!consent && !instance).

requiredConditions.condition: This design contract has been recorded by Operability+security jointly with Security+platform. This file existing is not that recording.
A per-invocation authorization record exists for this exact attempt, members closed as at authorizationRecord, resolution GRANTED.

Named consent via an admissible carrier (explicit invocation-time naming, or pre-existing policy). Not a carrier: component manifest, self-grant, implied by being root, credential presence, previous invocation.
Every product/slice prerequisite for that act and subtype is satisfied by owner-recorded admission evidence. This contract is never that evidence.
The act and subtype are classified. UNCLASSIFIED is unexercisable regardless of consent, regardless of this contract's recording, and regardless of an authorization record.

Class-specific gates at coveredActs also hold (CA-1 SPAWN: DR-G21 + admitted manifest; CA-1 IN_PROCESS: unexercisable in the architecture preview; CA-2: unexercisable in the architecture preview, even with a DR-119 exception; CA-3 KEYCHAIN: DR-108, currently deferred so unexercisable; CA-4: path classified HOST; component paths never authorized here).

failClosed.boolean: exercisable iff FC-C1 AND FC-C2 AND FC-C3 AND FC-C4 AND FC-C5 AND FC-C6. Absence of any conjunct denies.
failClosed.v1DefectRepaired: v1 failClosed.rule denied only an act with 'no named consent AND no recorded contract instance' — Boolean (!consent && !instance). That is repaired. Consent alone, a recorded design contract alone, or both without product admission, classification, or class-specific gates, still deny.
failClosed.noSilentDowngrade: A denied or unavailable host act does not cause doctor to answer an easier question under the same check id.
failClosed.unattemptedReports: An unattempted denied act reports CONSENT-REQUIRED or UNEXERCISABLE. It does not borrow INDETERMINATE. INDETERMINATE is only for an attempted act whose effect outcome is unknown.

authorizationRecord.cardinality: One record per attempted in-scope host act, including attempts that are then denied, refused, cancelled, fail, time out, or whose outcome is unknown.

closedMembers.name: id
closedMembers.semantics: Surface-local audit identity for this record. Not a RunId, EvidenceDigest, grant-generation id, or any DR-006 recipe. This contract mints no identity recipe.

closedMembers.name: actor
closedMembers.semantics: Host acting under the invoking user's direct instruction. Component actors are out of this schema.

closedMembers.name: actionSubtype
closedMembers.nullWhen: CA-2 only. A CA-1-HOST-HEAD record with null subtype is UNCLASSIFIED and DENIED. A CA-3 or CA-4-HOST record with a null or unnamed subtype is UNCLASSIFIED and must resolve DENIED. IN_PROCESS is classified and UNEXERCISABLE in the architecture preview.

closedMembers.name: componentGenerationIdentity
closedMembers.semantics: For CA-1 (SPAWN or IN_PROCESS): the exact component generation identity executed or requested. Required on every CA-1 authorization record that produces a consent record, including denied IN_PROCESS attempts. Absent, wildcard, or mismatch DENIES. Null with reason for other classes. This is structure over a DR-006-parked value; this contract mints no recipe.

closedMembers.name: admittedManifestDigest
closedMembers.semantics: For CA-1-HOST-HEAD: sha256 of the admitted manifest of that generation. Absent or mismatch DENIES. Null with reason for other classes.

closedMembers.name: designContractRef
closedMembers.semantics: Structured reference to the recorded design-contract instance this record was evaluated under: path, version, sha256. A stale, moved, or unrecorded ref DENIES. Existence of this JSON on disk is not a lawful ref.

closedMembers.name: invocationId
closedMembers.semantics: The doctor (or host) invocation this attempt belongs to. Invocation-local. Not persisted as a grant.

closedMembers.name: checkIds
closedMembers.semantics: Exact named checks this attempt is for. Empty is lawful only when the act is not check-scoped; it never means 'all checks'.

closedMembers.name: resourceScope
closedMembers.semantics: Exact enumeration of resources the act may touch. For CA-3, the exact paths, sockets/pipes, or facilities. Never a glob, never '*', never 'any', never empty-meaning-all.

closedMembers.name: toolIdentity
closedMembers.semantics: For CA-2: the exact declared external-system identity from the approved exception, never a name doctor constructed and never ambient PATH resolution. Null with reason for other classes.

closedMembers.name: endpointSet
closedMembers.semantics: For CA-4-HOST: the exact endpoint or endpoint set, enumerated, never a pattern. Null with reason for other classes.

closedMembers.name: platform
closedMembers.semantics: The platform the consent is given on. Windows is D-002-deferred and is not a grantable platform here.

closedMembers.name: policyProvenance
closedMembers.semantics: For pre-existing-policy: a source-identity object {authority, artifactPath, selector, digest}. Null with reason for invocation-time-naming. A string value refuses.

closedMembers.name: productAdmissionRefs
closedMembers.semantics: Closed array of { authority, artifactPath, selector, digest, standing, scope }. Empty means FC-C4 fails and resolution must be DENIED. A moved digest or unverifiable prose-only ref DENIES.

closedMembers.name: resolution
closedMembers.semantics: Authorization axis only. Not confinement. Not effect outcome. GRANTED is unlawful unless every failClosed conjunct holds.

closedMembers.name: owners
closedMembers.semantics: Operability+security jointly with Security+platform, as D-032 names them.

closedMembers.name: auditIdentity
closedMembers.semantics: The identity under which this record is auditable in the post-report. Surface-local. Not a DR-105 grant id.

authorizationRecord.wildcardRefusal: A record whose resourceScope, endpointSet, toolIdentity, or checkIds uses a wildcard, glob, pattern, or implicit-all is refused. Resolution DENIED. The act is unexercisable.
authorizationRecord.scopeMismatch: An attempt whose actual resource, tool, endpoint, check, actor, class, subtype, or platform is not exactly the record's bound is unauthorized even if a GRANTED record exists for a different bound. Relabeling after the request is accepted cannot change the required authorization.
authorizationRecord.notAGrant: This record is not a DR-105 grant, is not journaled, carries no sequence number, and does not survive the invocation.

doctorV4FieldMapping.rule: Total over the 19 authorizationRecord closed members AND over every legal value of those members. Key-set equality is necessary and not sufficient. A legal variant with no destination is a defect. An authorizationRecord member with no destination is a defect in this contract, not a licence to drop it. effectOutcome is not an authorizationRecord member; it is listed under notAnAuthorizationRecordMember.
doctorV4FieldMapping.cardinality: Doctor v4: one consent record per attempted consented action. A DENIED authorization record for an act that was never attempted produces no consent record. A DENIED or GRANTED record for an attempted act produces exactly one consent record. Absence of a consent record never means the outcome was nothing.

destinations.id: consentRecords[].id, or a surface-local cross-reference recorded in residualLimitation if the two ids must differ
destinations.actor: consentRecords[].scope.actor = HOST-UNDER-INSTRUCTION. Required. Unpopulated DENIES the report as incomplete.
destinations.actionSubtype: consentRecords[].scope.actionSubtype. Required for CA-1, CA-3, CA-4-HOST. Null only for CA-2. Unpopulated subtype on CA-1/CA-3/CA-4 is UNCLASSIFIED and DENIED, matching nullWhen and FC-C5.
destinations.componentGenerationIdentity: consentRecords[].scope.targetIdentity.generation for every CA-1 authorization record that produces a consent record, including denied IN_PROCESS attempts.
destinations.admittedManifestDigest: consentRecords[].scope.targetIdentity.admittedManifestDigest for every CA-1 authorization record that produces a consent record, including denied IN_PROCESS attempts.
destinations.designContractRef: consentRecords[].scope.designContractRef (path, version, sha256). Required on every attempted-act consent record. Dropped or relabeled digest fails FC-ROUND-TRIP.
destinations.resourceScope: consentRecords[].scope.resources; for CA-3 also consentRecords[].endpoint when the probe targeted a named resource
destinations.toolIdentity: consentRecords[].scope.targetIdentity.toolIdentity for CA-2. Not the targetIdentity object as a whole.
destinations.endpointSet: consentRecords[].scope.endpointSet = the authorized bound (including resolvers and intermediaries). consentRecords[].endpoint remains the exact endpoint(s) actually contacted. Conflating the two fails FC-ROUND-TRIP.
destinations.consentCarrier: Reconstructed only from a present policyProvenance member: JSON null reconstructs invocation-time-naming; a well-formed source-identity object reconstructs pre-existing-policy. Omitted policyProvenance has no inverse and refuses. residualLimitation is not a destination. Round-trip: carrier -> present null-or-object -> carrier MUST succeed for both closed values.
destinations.policyProvenance: authorizationRecord.policyProvenance and consentRecords[].scope.policyProvenance MUST be present. JSON null when consentCarrier is invocation-time-naming. Source-identity object when consentCarrier is pre-existing-policy. Omission of the member refuses. A string refuses. Never a third representation. Exact value equality: authorizationRecord.policyProvenance and consentRecords[].scope.policyProvenance MUST be identical (both JSON null, or objects with the same four members and equal field values). Relabel refuses.
destinations.productAdmissionRefs: consentRecords[].scope.productAdmissionRefs, same closed item shape. Dropped digest/selector/standing fails FC-ROUND-TRIP.
destinations.owners: consentRecords[].scope.owners. Required on every attempted-act consent record.
destinations.auditIdentity: consentRecords[].scope.auditIdentity. Required on every attempted-act consent record. May equal consentRecords[].id. A distinct handle is legal and must appear here, not only in prose. Unpopulated fails FC-ROUND-TRIP.

notAnAuthorizationRecordMember.effectOutcome: consentRecords[].effectOutcome as already bound. Listed so a reader does not treat the mapping key set as the member set.

consentRecordsScopeShape.additionalMembers: forbidden. Additive members require a successor of this contract and a doctor successor that accepts them.
consentRecordsScopeShape.relationToDoctorV4: Closed superset of doctor v4's scope obligation: checks, target identity, resources, observation deadline, and byte cap. Deadline and byte cap are observation/IO bounds, not authorization parameters (doctor v4 boundsAreNotPermissionParameters). Authorization-layer members (actor, actionSubtype, designContractRef, productAdmissionRefs, owners, auditIdentity, authorized endpointSet) are additional closed members of the same object.

members.name: actionSubtype
members.perClassBinding: When present, actionSubtype MUST be in the closed list for consentRecords[].actionClass (CA-1, CA-2, CA-3, CA-4). Cross-class values refuse. CA-2 remains null.

members.name: targetIdentity
members.nullWhen: CA-3 and CA-4; null carries an explicit reason
members.noTopLevelDuplicates: generation, admittedManifestDigest, and toolIdentity exist only inside this object. They are not top-level scope members.

members.name: clockRule
members.meaning: Doctor's clock ends an observation. It decides no authorization and no order. An expiry-shaped timestamp is forbidden.

members.name: byteCap
members.integerRule: every numeric member is a nonnegative integer 0..2^53-1

acceptFromTarget.meaning: output-acceptance bound on bytes doctor will read from the target

members.name: endpointSet
members.meaning: authorized bound, including resolvers and intermediaries. Not the actual contacted set.

members.name: auditIdentity
members.meaning: Exact destination for authorizationRecord.auditIdentity. May equal id. If distinct, this member carries the distinct handle.

classPredicateDomain.rule: Every when / nullWhen / requiredWhen predicate whose discriminator is consentRecords[].actionClass uses only these four literals. Authorization-record literals CA-1-HOST-HEAD and CA-4-HOST are forbidden in those predicates. Translation lives only at doctorV4FieldMapping. This rule does not quantify over consentCarrier-domain predicates.
classPredicateDomain.unmatchedSerializedClass: fails — every legal serialized class must select exactly one byteCap variant, the matching targetIdentity / endpointSet requiredness, AND the matching actionSubtype domain (CA-1: SPAWN|IN_PROCESS; CA-2: null; CA-3: OUT_OF_ROOT_READ|LOCAL_SOCKET_OR_PIPE|KEYCHAIN|PRIVILEGED_PLATFORM_FACILITY; CA-4: PATH-TRUST-STATE-REFRESH|PATH-INDEX-REACH|PATH-DECLARED-EXTERNAL-SERVICE).

consentCarrierPredicateDomain.rule: The discriminator is authorizationRecord.consentCarrier. policyProvenance MUST be a present JSON member. It is JSON null exactly when consentCarrier is invocation-time-naming. It is a present source-identity object exactly when consentCarrier is pre-existing-policy. Omission is not null and has no decoder. A string refuses. Two shapes only (unmatchedCarrier totality).
consentCarrierPredicateDomain.unmatchedCarrier: fails — every legal consentCarrier value must select null policyProvenance or a well-formed source-identity object, never both, never neither, never a string
consentCarrierPredicateDomain.roundTrip: consentCarrier invocation-time-naming <-> present JSON null. consentCarrier pre-existing-policy <-> present source-identity object. Omitted member refuses. Mismatch refuses.
consentCarrierPredicateDomain.omission: refuse — omitted policyProvenance is not a legal encoding of invocation-time-naming

effectCommit.rule: No not-yet-committed effect may commit after authorization ends. Authorization ends on cancel, process death, or invocation end.

boundaries.commit: The operating system has accepted creation of the child process (the irreversible process-creation acceptance), not the parent's later observation of a pid.
boundaries.afterCommit: The child's subsequent effects are DR-105. This contract cannot claim DEFINITELY_NOT_PERFORMED about those effects.
boundaries.unknownAcceptance: If it cannot be honestly stated whether the OS accepted creation, effectOutcome is INDETERMINATE. DEFINITELY_NOT_PERFORMED is unlawful in that race, including cancel or parent death during the syscall and the case where a child exists before the parent call returns.

boundaries.commit: The operating system has accepted creation of the customer-tool process, not the parent's later observation of a pid.
boundaries.afterCommit: The tool's subsequent effects are unbounded by OpenSIP (doctor v4 CA-2 honestBound). This contract cannot undo them.
boundaries.unknownAcceptance: Same as CA-1: unknown acceptance is INDETERMINATE, never DEFINITELY_NOT_PERFORMED.

boundaries.commit: The observation syscall has been issued to the OS.
boundaries.irreversibleAfterCommit: The observation (and any OS prompt it caused) cannot be un-observed.
boundaries.afterCommit: KEYCHAIN remains unexercisable while DR-108 is deferred, so this boundary is specified and unused for that subtype.

boundaries.commit: The operating system has accepted the first operation capable of causing network observation by a third party: name resolution, connect/handshake, send, or receive. Not the first application payload byte. DNS packets, TCP SYNs, QUIC packets, and TLS metadata are already commit.
boundaries.afterCommit: Bytes that have left the host cannot be recalled.
boundaries.unknownAcceptance: If it cannot be honestly stated whether any such operation was accepted, effectOutcome is INDETERMINATE. DEFINITELY_NOT_PERFORMED is unlawful after any of those operations.
boundaries.endpointScope: endpointSet must enumerate every endpoint the act may contact, including resolvers and connection intermediaries, never a pattern. An attempt that contacts an unenumerated resolver or intermediary is a scope mismatch and DENIED.

effectCommit.cancellationBeforeCommit: The act does not proceed. effectOutcome DEFINITELY_NOT_PERFORMED. execution remains a confinement axis and is not the outcome carrier.
effectCommit.cancellationAfterCommit: The effect has happened or may have happened. effectOutcome COMPLETED if durably observed, else INDETERMINATE. Never DEFINITELY_NOT_PERFORMED. Never execution=refused as a substitute.
effectCommit.processDeath: If commit-versus-not cannot be honestly stated, effectOutcome INDETERMINATE. Never refused. Never omitted. Never narrated only in residualLimitation. If doctor itself dies, doctor cannot write the post-report. A surviving supervisor (the process that spawned doctor, or the CI runner) is required to emit INDETERMINATE or a report-integrity failure. No such supervisor is minted here. The missing crash-report surface is UNOWNED-AND-NEEDED; owner assignment is a D-000 act for Operability+security jointly with Security+platform. Until a surviving writer is named and recorded, FC-PROCESS-DEATH-INDETERMINATE is a bounded obligation: it is required when a surviving writer exists; when none exists the attempt is UNEMITTED-CRASH and the fixture cannot be claimed to pass. That bound is not a waiver of honesty; it is a refusal to claim a report that nobody can write.
effectCommit.cleanup: Doctor writes the consent record after the fact. No inverse exists for irreversible classes. No grant revocation, because there is no grant. No pre-commit journal. Cleanup of uncommitted work is 'do not commit'.
effectCommit.whichProcessDeathEndsAuthorization: The host/doctor process that holds the authorization record. Component or tool death does not end host authorization; it is a child-lifecycle fact reported on the confinement/result axes.

unemittedCrash.definition: A review-side and fixture-side label for an attempted host act whose doctor/host process died and for which no surviving writer exists to emit a consent record. It is not an effectOutcome member. It is not a check status. It has no carrier until the crash-report surface is owned and recorded. Until then it names an absence, not a reportable value.
unemittedCrash.livesAt: effectCommit.processDeath and FC-PROCESS-DEATH-INDETERMINATE only. The future crash-report surface, once assigned, owns any durable carrier.

mandatoryMinimumPerD032.meaning: The host effect was durably observed to have happened.
The host effect was not performed. Not a revoke-undone claim. Unlawful after commit, and unlawful when commit-versus-not is unknown.
The host cannot honestly say whether the effect happened. Lawful only for an attempted act.

serialization.normativeBinding: For every attempted in-scope host act, once this design contract is recorded, effectOutcome MUST carry exactly one of COMPLETED, DEFINITELY_NOT_PERFORMED, INDETERMINATE. Unpopulated is unlawful for a host attempt after recording. Prose in residualLimitation is not a substitute. result is not a substitute. execution is not a substitute. A check status UNDETERMINED is not a substitute.

separateAxes.authorization: authorizationRecord.resolution and doctor v4 consentRecords[].authorization (requested → granted|denied).
separateAxes.confinement: doctor v4 consentRecords[].execution (enforced | disclosed-trusted-code | refused). refused means doctor did not perform the act. It may never be written for an initiated act whose outcome is unknown.
separateAxes.residualLimitation: doctor v4 consentRecords[].residualLimitation. Still mandatory and non-nullable. It does not carry the outcome.

outcomeVocabulary.permissionRef: Permanently reserved for host acts (D-032). Never populated for an in-scope host act.
outcomeVocabulary.enforcementDisclosure: WITHDRAWN for host acts under D-032 Option B, matching doctor v4's rule that the member is withdrawn rather than doctor-populated when host surfaces are outside the DR-105 vocabulary. Component-tail DISCLOSED obligations remain DR-105's.
outcomeVocabulary.notGrantJournalOutcomes: COMPLETED-BEFORE-REVOCATION and DR-105 INDETERMINATE-as-grant-outcome are not members. Those remain DR-105 component-tail outcomes.
outcomeVocabulary.doctorV4ReservedPoint: doctor v4 reserved effectOutcome on DR-105 and the actor decision. D-032 made the actor decision (Option B) and commissioned this contract to supply the host vocabulary. This artifact is that supply. DR-105's closure conditions the component half of the member; under D-032 Option B host acts are outside DR-105, so the host half does not wait on DR-105. doctor v4's unpopulated-plus-residual interim rule continues to govern component records and host records made before this contract is recorded. It does not amend doctor v4's header. A later doctor successor may restate the reserved point as activated for host acts; until then these bytes are the normative host binding.
outcomeVocabulary.whenKnowable: If the outcome is knowable it must be written (COMPLETED or DEFINITELY_NOT_PERFORMED). If not, INDETERMINATE must be written explicitly.

notCarriers: consent persisted from a previous invocation
consent.lifecycle: Bound to one invocation. Not journaled as a DR-105 grant. Cancel or process death ends authorization. Ending authorization cannot un-commit an already committed effect and cannot permit a not-yet-committed effect to commit.

CA-1-host-head.covers: Doctor v4 CA-1 host-actor surface: SPAWN (child process) and IN_PROCESS. Only SPAWN can become exercisable under this contract's other gates. IN_PROCESS is classified and denied for the architecture preview.
CA-1-host-head.admissionOwner: Security+platform / containment owners. This contract cannot admit the spawn.

subtypes.covers: Decision to spawn an admitted component as a child process. The child's subsequent effects are DR-105.
subtypes.previewStanding: Authorization-layer only. Still requires FC-C1..C6, including DR-G21 and admitted manifest.

subtypes.covers: Running admitted component code in the doctor/host address space (doctor v4 CA-1 in-process variant).
subtypes.previewStanding: UNEXERCISABLE in the architecture preview. Classified so it cannot be relabeled as SPAWN. No in-process commit boundary is used because the subtype cannot pass.

CA-2.admissionOwner: Product/language-closure owners for DR-119. This contract cannot admit the tool.
CA-2.previewStanding: UNEXERCISABLE for the architecture preview, every CA-2 execution, not only a 'network-capable' subset. Doctor v4's honestBound is that a customer tool is outside OpenSIP's signed closure and doctor cannot state what it reads, writes, or sends. Declared local-only is not enforced. This contract does not amend doctor v4. Within the host-effect authorization domain it governs, the declared-local-only branch of doctor v4 consentDoesNotCascade.theHardCase does not make a preview CA-2 exercisable. A later doctor successor may restate that recital. A later D-000 product/authorization decision owned by the DR-119 product owner jointly with Security+platform is required before any CA-2 is exercisable. That decision may not borrow host CA-4 or PT-NET-EGRESS for the tool's own sockets. Demonstrated no-network confinement, if ever claimed, is a product-admission condition of that later decision, not a classifier this contract evaluates.

subtypes.sliceSelector: D-002 includes consented doctor probes; it does not by itself admit this subtype
subtypes.standing: OPEN-NOT-ADMITTED. Owners are named. Admission evidence is ABSENT. Unexercisable until those owners record subtype admission. UNOWNED is reserved for a subtype with no named owner.

subtypes.sliceSelector: D-002 includes consented doctor probes; it does not by itself admit this subtype
subtypes.standing: OPEN-NOT-ADMITTED. Owners are named. Admission evidence is ABSENT. Unexercisable until those owners record subtype admission. UNOWNED is reserved for a subtype with no named owner.

subtypes.sliceSelector: D-002 explicitly defers DR-108; no credential-requiring features in the architecture preview

subtypes.productAdmissionAuthority: UNOWNED until a D-000 owner-assignment. D-002 does not name this subtype.
subtypes.standing: UNOWNED-FOR-ADMISSION. Unexercisable until a D-000 owner-assignment and owner-recorded admission exist.

CA-4-host.covers: Network send or receive by the doctor process itself.
CA-4-host.notCovers: Component-originated egress (DR-105 / PT-NET-EGRESS). Host consent cannot substitute for that permission.

slice1EgressExecutionSide.d032Assignment: Adopted D-032: 'Slice-1 doctor egress execution side remains for that contract.' This artifact is that contract. The assignment is answered here. It is not returned UNSETTLED.
slice1EgressExecutionSide.settledRule: The execution side is the process that opens the socket, not who named the consent.
slice1EgressExecutionSide.ES-1: Every network send or receive performed by the doctor process itself is HOST CA-4.
slice1EgressExecutionSide.ES-2: SPLIT. ES-2a: every network send or receive by an admitted component process doctor spawned under CA-1 SPAWN is component-originated egress, exclusively DR-105 / PT-NET-EGRESS. This contract cannot authorize it. Host consent cannot substitute. ES-2b: every network send or receive by a CA-2 customer-owned tool is not an admitted-component act and is not PT-NET-EGRESS. A customer tool is not made a component by being spawned. This contract cannot authorize those sockets. Host CA-4 never authorizes the tool's own sockets. Because doctor cannot state what a CA-2 tool sends, every CA-2 execution is UNEXERCISABLE in the architecture preview. There is no 'network-capable' classifier in this contract.
slice1EgressExecutionSide.ES-3: An unnamed doctor-process socket is UNCLASSIFIED and UNEXERCISABLE regardless of consent, regardless of this contract's recording, and regardless of an authorization record. No unless-bypass exists.

namedArchitecturePreviewPaths.source: doctor v4 CA-4 covers 'refreshing revocation state'
namedArchitecturePreviewPaths.productAdmission: OPEN-NOT-ADMITTED for architecture preview. D-002 doctor's default is no-network; this is a consented departure. Unexercisable until Operability+security jointly with Security+platform record preview admission, this contract is recorded, named CA-4 consent exists, and endpointSet is exact.

namedArchitecturePreviewPaths.source: doctor v4 CA-4 covers 'reaching an index'
namedArchitecturePreviewPaths.executionSide: HOST when the doctor process opens the socket
namedArchitecturePreviewPaths.productAdmission: OPEN-NOT-ADMITTED for architecture preview. D-002 does not require doctor to reach an index. Unexercisable until admission is recorded.

namedArchitecturePreviewPaths.source: doctor v4 CA-4 covers 'contacting a declared external service'
namedArchitecturePreviewPaths.executionSide: HOST when the doctor process opens the socket
namedArchitecturePreviewPaths.productAdmission: OPEN-NOT-ADMITTED for architecture preview. DR-128 excludes third-party/untrusted from MVP; first-party declared services are still unadmitted here. Unexercisable until admission is recorded.

namedArchitecturePreviewPaths.authorization: DR-105 / PT-NET-EGRESS exclusively. This contract cannot authorize it.

Not this contract. Not DR-105 / PT-NET-EGRESS. Architecture preview: every CA-2 execution is UNEXERCISABLE. Later admission, if any, is a D-000 product/authorization decision owned by the DR-119 product owner jointly with Security+platform. A separate host CA-4 for doctor's own related socket still does not authorize the tool's sockets. Declared local-only is not a classifier and is not enforcement.

slice1EgressExecutionSide.remainderOwner: Classification of a doctor-process path not named above is owned by Operability+security jointly with Security+platform and is recorded only in a successor of THIS artifact. This contract is the terminus of the D-032 assignment. Unclassified is a fail-closed remainder, not a deferral to nobody.
slice1EgressExecutionSide.v1DefectRepaired: v1 marked the side UNSETTLED and then permitted host CA-4 'unless explicitly consented and this contract instance exists.' acceptanceEvidenceFixtureClasses.passProperty: An unnamed host act is unexercisable. Absence never permits.
Named consent with this design contract unrecorded still denies.
A recorded design contract with no named consent still denies.

Named consent plus recorded design contract plus a GRANTED-shaped record with empty productAdmissionRefs still denies. Covers CA-2 without DR-119, CA-1 without DR-G21, and each UNOWNED-FOR-ADMISSION CA-3 subtype.

With a recorded contract instance and named consent present, CA-2 remains unexercisable in the architecture preview even when a DR-119 approved exception is present; DR-119 is necessary and not sufficient. CA-1 SPAWN remains unexercisable while DR-G21 is absent. CA-1 IN_PROCESS remains unexercisable. KEYCHAIN remains unexercisable while DR-108 is deferred.

Each of COMPLETED, DEFINITELY_NOT_PERFORMED, INDETERMINATE is distinguishable at consentRecords[].effectOutcome. A fixture that places the value on execution, result, residualLimitation, or a check status fails. A prose-only encoding fails. An unpopulated effectOutcome on an attempted host act after this contract is recorded fails.
Spawning a component does not put the child's effects under this contract.
KEYCHAIN remains unexercisable while DR-108 is deferred.

An unclassified doctor-process socket cannot run, including when named consent and a recorded design contract exist. Actor relabeling after the request is accepted cannot change the required authorization.
An attempt whose actual resource, tool, endpoint, check, class, subtype, or platform is not exactly the authorization record's bound is denied.
A wildcard, glob, pattern, or implicit-all in resourceScope, endpointSet, toolIdentity, or checkIds is refused.

Cancel before OS process-creation acceptance yields DEFINITELY_NOT_PERFORMED. Cancel during the syscall, or after OS acceptance but before the parent observes a pid, cannot produce DEFINITELY_NOT_PERFORMED; outcome is COMPLETED or INDETERMINATE.
Cancel after the class commit boundary cannot produce DEFINITELY_NOT_PERFORMED. Outcome is COMPLETED or INDETERMINATE.

When a surviving writer exists, process death with unknown commit-versus-not yields INDETERMINATE at effectOutcome, never refused, never omitted, never prose-only. When no surviving writer exists, the fixture cannot be claimed to pass; the attempt is UNEMITTED-CRASH.
A GRANTED CA-1 record bound to generation G1 / manifest M1 cannot authorize spawning G2 or M2 in the same invocation. Absent componentGenerationIdentity or admittedManifestDigest denies.
A CA-1 attempt whose actual admitted-manifest digest is not the record's admittedManifestDigest is denied.
A GRANTED host CA-4 record never authorizes a CA-2 tool's own socket. Every CA-2 attempt in the architecture preview is unexercisable, including a tool declared local-only that then opens a socket.
An authorization record whose designContractRef digest does not match the recorded contract instance, or whose productAdmissionRefs digest has moved, is denied.

An attempted-act consent record fails if it drops or relabels any of: actor, actionSubtype, designContractRef digest, productAdmissionRefs digest/selector/standing, owners, auditIdentity (including a distinct handle), componentGenerationIdentity, admittedManifestDigest, authorized endpointSet, or policyProvenance. Authorized endpointSet and actual consentRecords[].endpoint must remain distinguishable. Denied CA-1 IN_PROCESS attempts that produce a consent record must still carry generation and manifest digest. authorizationRecord.policyProvenance must equal consentRecords[].scope.policyProvenance; dropping or relabeling the projection refuses.
A CA-1 IN_PROCESS authorization record resolves DENIED in the architecture preview even with named consent, recorded contract, and generation/manifest bound.
Every CA-2 attempt in the architecture preview is unexercisable, including declared-local-only tools and tools with a DR-119 exception.
Cancel or death after DNS, connect/handshake, or receive acceptance, but before an application payload byte, cannot produce DEFINITELY_NOT_PERFORMED.

A consentRecords[].scope that omits observationDeadline, or omits byteCap on CA-1/CA-2/CA-4, or places generation/admittedManifestDigest/toolIdentity at top level, or uses a CA-1 targetIdentity that carries toolIdentity, or a CA-2 targetIdentity that carries generation, or a non-object targetIdentity for CA-1/CA-2, fails. All four action classes are tested.

Rejects: empty or open byteCap; missing or swapped CA-4 send/receive; wrong units or types or ranges; extra keys; malformed observationDeadline; expiry-shaped or instant-shaped deadline; CA-3 byteCap that is non-null; CA-1/CA-2 byteCap missing acceptFromTarget. Concrete parent records: consentRecords[].actionClass CA-1 selects acceptFromTarget; CA-2 selects acceptFromTarget; CA-4 selects send+receive; CA-3 selects null + NOT-APPLICABLE-NO-IO-BOUND; no legal serialized class is unmatched. A predicate that uses CA-4-HOST or CA-1-HOST-HEAD inside this scope shape fails the fixture.

Decided on authorizationRecord.consentCarrier. policyProvenance must be present. invocation-time-naming requires JSON null. pre-existing-policy requires a source-identity object. Omitted member refuses. String refuses. Malformed object (missing member, bad digest, extra key) refuses. Round-trip uses present-null and present-object only. Exact equality of AR and scope policyProvenance is required; two different valid objects refuse.

honestyRepairsKeyRule: GOVERNING. honestyRepairsFromVN lists findings raised against version N whose register disposition is REPAIRED, repaired in a successor. It is not the generation that performed the repair. Refiling is not withdrawal. predecessorVerdictFindings is maintained from v6 onward with path, digest, verdict, and per-finding dispositions. Every REPAIRED finding id in predecessorVerdictFindings for v8 onward MUST appear in honestyRepairsFromVN. ADVISORY-NON-BLOCKING findings MUST appear in that generation's register findings[] and MUST NOT appear in honestyRepairsFromVN. A finding discharged by the same successor edit as another finding still gets its own FromVN entry (joint-coverage) if and only if its disposition is REPAIRED. The register entry for round N MUST be complete against both frozen verdicts of round N at the time the successor is authored, compared per reviewerLane as (id, severity) by registerCoverageRule. A frozen BLOCKER or SHOULD-FIX cannot be registered ADVISORY-NON-BLOCKING. This obligation attaches to the current round, not only to rounds already closed. registerCoverageRule, frozenReviewFindingExtractor, and fromVnIdExtractionRule are the mechanical checks. Repair-array keys match honestyRepairsFromV[0-9]+ only; fromVnIdExtractionRule is not a repair array.

registerCoverageRule.when: whenever a successor register entry for round N is authored
registerCoverageRule.laneCheck: for each reviewerLane in {claude2, codex}: run provenanceCheck then terminalStatusCheck then verdictEligibility then extract (id, severity) pairs via frozenReviewFindingExtractor; an unrecognized, mixed, failed type/count, provenance, status, or verdict-eligibility check REFUSES the successor; the set of (id, severity) in predecessorVerdictFindings[N][lane].findings[] MUST equal the extracted set; then run verdictConsistencyCheck
registerCoverageRule.pairCheck: the set of (reviewerLane, findingId, severity) triples in the register entry MUST be unique and MUST equal the set of (lane, id, severity) triples extracted from the two pinned verdicts; a swapped-lane, missing-severity, or cross-lane duplicate fails
registerCoverageRule.dispositionCheck: disposition MUST be one of registerDispositionVocabulary.closedValues. A frozen BLOCKER or SHOULD-FIX MUST have register disposition REPAIRED and MUST NOT have ADVISORY-NON-BLOCKING. A frozen ADVISORY MUST have ADVISORY-NON-BLOCKING. A blocking finding that is only partly addressed is not representable as REPAIRED; the successor refuses.
registerCoverageRule.fromVnCheck: every register finding whose disposition is REPAIRED MUST appear as a fromVnIdExtractionRule result for honestyRepairsFromV[0-9]+ after findingIdRule validation; ADVISORY-NON-BLOCKING MUST NOT appear there
registerCoverageRule.resultIfIncomplete: the successor refuses; do not claim REPAIRED for a coverage finding
registerCoverageRule.enforcement: authoring a successor includes the per-lane (id, severity) frozen-review coverage check
registerCoverageRule.idCheck: every register finding.id MUST satisfy findingIdRule
registerCoverageRule.provenanceCheck: Before frozenReviewFindingExtractor reads a lane: predecessorVerdictFindings[N][lane].path MUST exist as a file; the sha256 of that file's bytes MUST equal the recorded sha256; a missing path or digest mismatch REFUSES and MUST NOT extract. The recorded verdict MUST equal that pinned file's verdict field exactly.
registerCoverageRule.verdictConsistencyCheck: ACCEPT iff zero BLOCKER and zero SHOULD-FIX. REJECT iff at least one BLOCKER or SHOULD-FIX. This matches the standing 0-blocker 0-SHOULD-FIX ACCEPT gate.
registerCoverageRule.terminalStatusCheck: A pinned review is terminal-eligible only if: (1) its path and sha256 match an entry in legacyVerdictOnlyReviews, in which case it is eligible on verdict alone; or (2) it has a present reviewStatus or reviewState equal to COMPLETE or COMPLETED. A file with both status members absent whose digest is not on that list REFUSES. A present non-COMPLETE status REFUSES. Do not infer COMPLETE from the register field.
registerCoverageRule.verdictEligibility: The recorded and pinned verdict MUST be exactly ACCEPT or REJECT. Any other type or value REFUSES. ACCEPT if and only if the lane has zero BLOCKER and zero SHOULD-FIX findings. REJECT if and only if the lane has at least one BLOCKER or SHOULD-FIX finding.

combinedFindingsArray.when: findings is an array of objects (empty array allowed)
combinedFindingsArray.idsAndSeverity: each (object.id, object.severity) in findings[], in array order; severity MUST be BLOCKER, SHOULD-FIX, or ADVISORY
combinedFindingsArray.presentSeverityMembers: each present blockers/shouldFix/advisories member MUST be a nonnegative integer count; an array or any other type REFUSES
combinedFindingsArray.perSeverityCount: for each present integer count, the number of extracted pairs with that severity MUST equal the integer; absent integers are not treated as 0 and are not checked

severityArrays.when: findings is absent AND at least one of blockers/shouldFix/advisories is an array of objects or a zero integer count
severityArrays.presentSeverityMembers: each present blockers/shouldFix/advisories member MUST be an array of objects or the integer 0; a positive integer, negative integer, object, string, or array-of-scalars REFUSES
severityArrays.idsAndSeverity: for each object-array key, each item yields (id, severity-of-that-key) where blockers=BLOCKER, shouldFix=SHOULD-FIX, advisories=ADVISORY; an item.severity that disagrees REFUSES

frozenReviewFindingExtractor.selection: If findings is an array of objects, use combinedFindingsArray and validate every present severity member as a nonnegative integer before extraction. Else if findings is absent and a present severity member is an object array or integer 0, use severityArrays and validate every present severity member as an object array or integer 0. A file that matches neither, or that has findings present but not an object array, is an unrecognized or mixed schema and REFUSES. Never extract the empty set for an unrecognized schema.
frozenReviewFindingExtractor.emptyExtraction: Permit an empty extraction only for a recognized schema that proves zero findings: combinedFindingsArray with findings=[] and every present integer count 0 or absent; or severityArrays where every present severity key is an empty object array or integer 0.
frozenReviewFindingExtractor.keyTypeTotality: Every present severity key MUST be an array of objects or a nonnegative integer. Any other shape REFUSES, whether or not a sibling key produced ids.
frozenReviewFindingExtractor.unrecognized: refuse — successor authoring fails; do not treat as zero findings
frozenReviewFindingExtractor.lane: claude2 extracts only from the pinned Claude verdict; codex extracts only from the pinned Codex verdict
frozenReviewFindingExtractor.uniqueness: a duplicate canonical id inside one extracted lane refuses
frozenReviewFindingExtractor.idRule: every extracted object.id MUST satisfy findingIdRule; absent, null, boolean, numeric, object, array, empty, whitespace-only, and colon-containing ids REFUSE

honestyRepairsFromV16: HAE16-CX-01: raised against v16. honestyRepairsFromVN required only for register rows whose disposition is REPAIRED. ADVISORY-NON-BLOCKING ids removed from the repair arrays and kept in predecessorVerdictFindings.

HAE16-CX-02: raised against v16. registerCoverageRule compares each reviewerLane to that lane's pinned frozen verdict via frozenReviewFindingExtractor; (reviewerLane, findingId) pairs must be unique and equal; fromVnIdExtractionRule is the prefix before the first colon.

fromVnIdExtractionRule.rule: Repair arrays are only top-level keys matching honestyRepairsFromV[0-9]+. Each element of those arrays is a string; the canonical id is the substring before the first ':' ; that prefix MUST satisfy findingIdRule and MUST be unique within the array. fromVnIdExtractionRule is not itself a repair array.
fromVnIdExtractionRule.appliesTo: REPAIRED register findings only; ADVISORY-NON-BLOCKING MUST NOT appear as a prefix
fromVnIdExtractionRule.idRule: the canonical prefix MUST satisfy findingIdRule before any equality check; an empty or noncanonical prefix cannot represent a repaired finding
